feature: hobin-feature Stop hook: the session registry
request: Fix the hobin-feature Stop hook at the root. P1: record discovery follows symbolic links and crashes on ENOENT/ELOOP. P2: a checker crash and an incomplete record both exit 2. P3: the hook checks every record under the cwd tree, not only the session's. P4: mtime attribution treats another session's writes as this session's. P5: scenarios.mjs run without a path runs the whole tree. Decisions: D1 attribute records with a ledger filled by Pre/PostToolUse and check only ledger records on Stop; D2 leave the sibling hook-input.mjs hooks to a separate PR; D3 keep the no-argument behavior of scenarios.mjs and make the skill pass the record path. Revised (0.6.0, docs/plans/2026-11-06-feature-records-carry-their-session.md): a session registry at the session's start directory, created by the hook and appended by scenarios.mjs init/register/run/decline (fail closed without it) and by edit tools; Stop gates exactly the registry's records; decline is a record; the MCP record tools, the ledger and any directory search are removed.

condition_table.note: Which records Stop gates, and when the scripts refuse.
rows: record listed in this session's registry -> checked (F8, F9, F13, F14); missing -> reported (F21); not listed, or in another session's registry -> never checked (F5, F6, F25)
registry location: the SessionStart cwd, remembered; a later hook cwd never moves it (F10, F11)

script with a session id: registry found from cwd upward -> registers the absolute path (F8, F9); none -> exit 2, nothing created or run (F7, F23, F28); no session id or --no-gate -> proceeds unregistered (F7, F28); check and the gate -> register nothing (F20)
edit tools: Claude Write/Edit/MultiEdit, Codex apply_patch Add/Update/Move to of an existing record file -> registered; anything else -> nothing (F15)
obligation and an empty registry -> Stop names the exact commands and the start directory (F22); a declined record counts (F23) but exempts no other (F24)
no session_id -> nothing (F16); checker throws -> exit 1, never 2 (F12); at most three blocks in a row (F13)

decisions.question: How does the Stop hook decide which records belong to this session?
decisions.decision: A per-session ledger filled by PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks; Stop checks only ledger records and never walks the tree
decisions.reason: mtime attribution checked other sessions' records (701 records under a parent folder) and walked large trees on every stop
decisions.revert: Restore the mtime walk in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs, drop the PreToolUse/PostToolUse entries from both hooks.json files, and update F5, F6, F15

decisions.question: Do the sibling hooks sharing hook-input.mjs (review, stances, learning) change in this PR?
decisions.reason: Keep this change to one plugin and its guarantees
decisions.revert: Not applicable; the follow-up PR applies the same walker to hook-input.mjs

decisions.question: What does scenarios.mjs run/check do without a path?
decisions.decision: Unchanged (every record under the cwd); the skill now passes the record path
decisions.reason: Existing users rely on the no-argument form; a refusal would break them
decisions.revert: Make the no-argument form refuse more than one record and update F19

decisions.question: What does Stop do when a checker throws (not a record problem)?
decisions.decision: Exit 1 with a message naming it an internal error: visible to the user, never blocking the model
decisions.reason: A hook must not send the model back for the hook's own failure; exit 0 would hide it
decisions.revert: Change the exit code in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs and F12

decisions.question: Which root does a record get checked against?
decisions.decision: The hook root when it lies inside a git work tree and contains the record (unchanged behavior); otherwise the record's nearest ancestor holding .git; otherwise the hook root
decisions.reason: Keeps every in-repository session exactly as before and fixes the parent-folder case
decisions.revert: Always use the hook root in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs and drop F14

decisions.question: What counts for a shell command without a usable stamp (no PreToolUse, no tool_use_id, or an unreadable stamp)?
decisions.decision: Only record paths named in the command and changed since the session started; no walk
decisions.reason: Without a trustworthy start time a walk cannot tell this call's writes from anyone else's; a shared or empty stamp would claim every record under the cwd
decisions.revert: Change readStamp and the fallback in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs and F17, F22

decisions.question: Do record discovery walks follow symbolic links?
decisions.decision: No; symlinked directories and files are skipped, and an unreadable entry is skipped
decisions.reason: Following links is what crashed (ENOENT, ELOOP); a record behind a link is still checked when named by path
decisions.revert: Follow links with a visited-realpath set in core/developing-features/scripts/records.mjs

decisions.question: Where does the ledger live, and what happens if it is lost?
decisions.decision: Files per session_id in the host's plugin data directory (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA; Codex PLUGIN_DATA or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA), OS temp only when neither is set; SessionEnd removes them and Stop/SessionEnd prune files older than seven days
decisions.reason: Persistent, per plugin, given to hooks by both hosts; cleanup keeps it bounded; losing it only stops enforcement for that session
decisions.revert: Point stateDir in records.mjs back at the OS temp directory and drop the SessionEnd hooks

decisions.question: What should a record show while scenarios.mjs run is in progress or after it was killed?
decisions.decision: Mark every result running and write verification.run {startedAt, lastProgressAt} first, save after each scenario and the existing tests, delete verification.run when the run ends (also on a throw); check and Stop treat a present verification.run as incomplete and say: wait if still running, run again if stopped; no liveness claim
decisions.reason: An interrupted run must never leave earlier passes that check accepts (G6); state in the record needs no temp directory shared with the hook, and a pid check could not be trusted across machines or pid reuse
decisions.revert: Restore the single write at the end of run

decisions.question: Should run accept an --only list of scenario ids?
decisions.reason: A partial run cannot show the other scenarios still pass after a code change (G5 last run)
decisions.revert: Add --only together with a code fingerprint per result

decisions.question: How does the hook know a record is the session's, wherever it lives?
decisions.decision: Only structured tool calls count: successful calls of the plugin's records tools (MCP init, register, check; decline for the reason) by tool_input.path, and edit tools by their exact path; never shell text, command output, environment variables, shared temp directories or the file tree
decisions.reason: Directory inference measured 2.7 s and 4.6 s with 743 false records; the session-id-plus-shared-TMPDIR revision depended on host environment details; output markers were still text inference (any read output could carry one, background runs were invisible). Hooks observe MCP calls on both hosts with structured input
decisions.revert: Drop the records server and the MCP branch of the hook, and restore marker parsing from tool output (revision 3)

decisions.question: When must the session produce a record?
decisions.decision: Once developing-features starts by a fixed identifier (Claude Skill tool / slash prompt, Codex $mention / SKILL.md read); released only by a registered record or a decline tool call with a reason
decisions.reason: A record written outside the tools would otherwise silently escape the gate
decisions.revert: Drop the obligation branch in stop() and the UserPromptSubmit/Skill hooks

decisions.question: Does a decline exempt records already registered?
decisions.decision: No; it lifts only the 'no record yet' obligation
decisions.reason: Conservative: a registered record that fails is still unverified work
decisions.revert: Skip checkRecords when a decline exists

decisions.question: Which work goes through the records tools and which stays in the shell?
decisions.decision: Record operations (init, register, check, decline) are MCP tools; executing scenario checks and existing tests stays scenarios.mjs run in the shell
decisions.reason: Stdio MCP servers run outside the host sandbox (Codex stdio_server_launcher), so the server must never execute project commands; the shell keeps the host's sandbox and approvals
decisions.revert: Not applicable without giving the server a sandbox; keep run in the shell

decisions.question: How do the tools resolve a relative path?
decisions.decision: They refuse it (isError) and ask for an absolute path; the hook resolves a relative tool_input.path against the hook cwd only as a fallback
decisions.reason: The server's working directory is the plugin root on Codex, not the project; resolving there would create the record in the plugin cache
decisions.revert: Accept relative paths in record-tools.mjs once the host passes the project root to the server

decisions.question: Does a failed records tool call register its path?
decisions.decision: No: Claude routes failures to PostToolUseFailure, which the hook does not subscribe to; on Codex a result with isError is ignored
decisions.reason: A refused init over an existing file is not the session's record by that call; register exists for that
decisions.revert: Subscribe to PostToolUseFailure on Claude and drop failed() in the hook

decisions.question: Should the records tools ask for permission on each call?
decisions.decision: Never: on Claude a PreToolUse hook allows exactly the four tools (deny and ask rules still apply); on Codex the annotations plus default_tools_approval_mode approve
decisions.reason: The user: a permission prompt on every MCP call makes the plugin unusable. Plugin settings cannot carry permissions, and skill allowed-tools clears after the turn
decisions.revert: Drop the PreToolUse entry from the Claude hooks.json and default_tools_approval_mode from the Codex .mcp.json
